narration: Your $3,000 holiday bonus just hit your bank — but it's only $2,340. That $660 didn't just vanish. The IRS has a flat rule most workers never see coming.
visual: Dark background. Envelope labeled '$3,000' springs in, then a bank display counter animates from $3,000 down to $2,340. Text below: 'WHERE DID $660 GO?'

narration: It's called the supplemental wage rate. The IRS tells every company to withhold a flat 22% from bonuses before the money ever reaches you. It's not your actual tax bracket — it's just a preset rule.
visual: Light background. Giant '22%' in amber springs into center. SVG tax document below with 'SUPPLEMENTAL RATE' highlighted. Text: 'FLAT RATE. NO EXCEPTIONS.'

narration: Here's the thing — if your bonus clears a million dollars, that rate jumps all the way to 37%. But even at 22%, most people assume their boss just took too much and never look into getting it back.
visual: Dark background. Two money bags side by side: left labeled '$3,000 BONUS -22%', right labeled '$1M+ BONUS -37%'. Text below: 'BOTH AREN'T YOUR REAL TAX RATE.'

narration: Number one — if your company allows it, redirect part of your bonus straight into your 401k before taxes touch it. You move money into retirement, and the IRS can't tax what it never sees.
visual: Light background. '01' in large amber text. Animated arrow from paycheck SVG to piggy bank labeled '401K'. Text: 'REDIRECT BEFORE TAXES BITE.'

narration: Number two — even if you can't do that, your tax return will true everything up at the end of the year. If your real effective rate is under 22%, the IRS actually owes you the difference back.
visual: Dark background. '02' in amber. Animated arrow from '1040 TAX RETURN' form SVG to wallet with '$418 BACK' emerging from it. Text: 'IF YOUR REAL RATE IS UNDER 22%, THEY GIVE IT BACK.'

narration: Your bonus isn't fake money — but it won't feel full-sized until you understand this rule. Know the withholding trap, make one of these moves, and keep more of what your boss actually gave you.
visual: Light background. Person silhouette holding a money bag with green checkmark badge. CTA box: 'KNOW YOUR BONUS TAX. KEEP MORE.' Follow prompt at bottom.
